title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction: This page holds only the last two lines of a computation begun on p.130 (ms. p.355), part of §43–44 of the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets'. The setting is the profinite fundamental group π̂_{0,3} of P^1 minus three points, inside the extended mapping-class/Teichmüller group Γ̂_{0,3}. Γ̂_{0,3} also contains orientation-reversing ('anti-holomorphic', reflection-type) elements; Γ̂^+_{0,3} is the orientation-preserving part, and the outer quotient is 𝔖_{0,3}, with 𝔖^+_{0,3} ≅ 𝔖_3. The order-2 generator σ_∞ acts on π, and one studies solutions h of the 'loop equation' h·σ_∞(h)=1 (eq. (35)). This is the condition that u(σ_∞)=hσ_∞ is again an involution. The solutions are written in a coboundary form (36), presumably h = β σ_∞(β)^{-1}, a 1-cocycle/coboundary description. On p.130 Grothendieck uses (and admits in the profinite case) that the fixed subgroup π^{σ_∞} is trivial. The parametrizing β can then be taken in a larger group, and its indeterminacy is the σ_∞-centralizer (40): 𝔖_{0,3}^{σ_∞} ≅ Z/2×Z/2, generated by σ_∞ and a reflection τ_∞. So β = β_0 σ_∞^ε τ_∞^{ε'} with ε, ε' ∈ Z/2 (eq. (41)). This page concludes that β lies in the orientation-preserving group 𝔖^+_{0,3} if and only if ε'=0. The reason is that τ_∞ reverses orientation while σ_∞ preserves it. Thus, among orientation-preserving parametrizations, the residual ambiguity is only the Z/2 generated by σ_∞. Grothendieck then restarts the notation in §44 (next page), parametrizing automorphisms u of Γ̂^+_{0,3} inducing the identity on 𝔖_3 by pairs (h,g) with hσ_∞(h)=1 and gρ(g)ρ²(g)=1. These are the first two of the standard GT-type relations.
errors: No mathematical error on this page. The claim is immediate once τ_∞ is identified as orientation-reversing and σ_∞ as orientation-preserving. Since π̂ ∩ 𝔖 is not literally meaningful, 'β ∈ 𝔖_{0,3}' must be read as β in the relevant extension of 𝔖 by π (or as a lift), a looseness of notation that Grothendieck himself flags for revision in §46.

ideas.what: Restricting the Z/2×Z/2 ambiguity in the coboundary parametrization of solutions of hσ_∞(h)=1 to the orientation-preserving part, which leaves only ⟨σ_∞⟩
ideas.modern_name: Centralizer/indeterminacy of a coboundary parametrization (non-abelian H^1 of Z/2) in the profinite braid/Teichmüller tower; the first ('two-cycle') relation of Drinfeld–Ihara GT
ideas.usually_credited_to: Drinfeld (1990) and Ihara (1990–91) for the GT relations f(x,y)f(y,x)=1; Lochak–Schneps and others for the involution/parametrization analyses
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme only sketches the 'jeu de Lego' Teichmüller and the action of Gal(Q̄/Q) on π̂_{0,3}; this detailed computation is not there as far as I know

deep.surprise_reason: This is a two-line remark concluding a routine sign/orientation bookkeeping: ε'=0 exactly when β is orientation-preserving. It is part of Grothendieck's independent derivation of GT-type equations. The broader context is historically interesting, but this page adds nothing beyond what follows trivially from the previous page.
transcription_corrections: The symbol after β is not \widehat{GT}^+_{0,3}. The image shows a script/Fraktur S with superscript + and subscript 0,3, i.e. β ∈ 𝔖^+_{0,3}, consistent with the notation 𝔖_{0,3} on the previous page.
'il f. et s.' abbreviates 'il faut et il suffit'.
The first line reads roughly '(avec ε, ε' des quantités déterminées). Pour'. The handwriting is very compressed and the words around 'quantités déterminées' are uncertain.
